summary: Draft MinerPass operation eligibility and staged acceptance requirements
details: Add UIP-0016 Draft for one-time zero-balance enrollment, source-qualified same-owner operations, and single-source cross-owner inheritance, based on issue 51.
Document 18 acceptance scenarios and the implementation sequence for historical input evidence, transaction-boundary balances, atomic state transitions, replay, and wallet verification.
This documentation introduces no runtime rule, activation, network reset, or completed security-fix claim; version and encoding candidates still require implementation validation.
